en: Black-and-white postcard view of a town square with a low three-story brick building in the background, identified as the post office. In the foreground is a landscaped park area with paths, benches, flowerbeds, and a large leafy tree. To the right stands a prominent statue of a nude female figure raising an arm, set on a stone plinth. People are sitting on benches and walking through the square. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom of the image, along with the photographer/publisher information.
